appName.message: Captcha Plugin: Turnstile Solver by Raptor

appDescription.message:
❗❗Use the latest version of Chrome — in versions older than a week, Turnstile may not register the click on some sites❗❗
The plugin automatically solves Cloudflare Turnstile challenges.

Features:
 - Solves Cloudflare Turnstile by emulating cursor movement and a mouse click
 - Free
 - No API key needed, no payments required
 - No registration required, works right after installation

Usage details:
 - In settings, you can enable/disable the plugin
 - You can set a delay before solving

Drawbacks:
 - Requires the latest version of Chrome — if the version isn't up to date, Cloudflare may sometimes detect it as a bot and not register the click
 - Launches Chrome in remote debugging mode, and a "started debugging this browser" window appears

This is the first public version of the plugin. Register at captchaplugin.com to get information about new versions and plugins for other captchas. Registration is not required for the extension to work.

reCaptcha extension: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/free-ai-recaptcha-solver/iomcoelgdkghlligeempdbfcaobodacg
